_comment: Installer-size budget gate (product bar #66 lane 5, issue #72). baseline_display is what the v0.1.1 release page shows (github.com/kahlanhamza/IUM/releases/tag/v0.1.1, measured 2026-11-06); baseline_bytes is that display value in bytes (MB = 1024*1024), kept for the headroom column. max_bytes is the ship ceiling: exceeding it FAILS the release job. Growth is a reviewed diff to this table, never a silent ship. #118 reviewed growth (2026-11-15): every installer now ships the pinned rclone sidecar (81.8 MiB unpacked; ~20-30 MiB compressed per bundle format) — a clean machine needs NO rclone install before a single destination lights up. Ceilings re-measured with the sidecar's real compressed cost per format plus headroom; baselines stay historical (v0.1.1).
baseline_source: v0.1.1 release assets as displayed on the release page, 2026-11-06
